Artefacts, Information, and Instructions

An extension of loze.ttl with classes and predicates related to artefacts, information artefacts, and instructions

https://loze-ontology.org/artefacts-information-and-instructions
ttlrdfjsonldnt
9 terms
Class

Artefact

An object that is designed and made by humans for serving certain purposes or functions

Property

has Instruction

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and an information artefact i if and only if i is the instruction in e

Property

has Recipe

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and an information artefact i if and only if i is the recipe in e

Property

has Standard

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a particular p if and only if p is the standard in e

Class

Information Artefact

An artefact that consists of a structured system of symbols' occurrences meant to convey information

Property

is Instruction In

The sub-relation of loze:isStandardIn that obtains when the standard in question is an information artefact consisting of instructions for performing

Property

is Recipe In

The sub-relation of loze:isInstructionIn that obtains when the instructions in question prescribes the ingredient ratio and/or doses and the procedure

Property

is Standard In

The sub-relation of loze:isTopicIn that obtains when the topic provides the rules or standard for the performance of the eventuality

Class

Text

An information artefact that consists of sentences in some human-readable language and is meant to convey meaning to humans

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
